quests.title: Pioneers

dialogue.t: We've never been here before. Where is this, exactly?
Huh? Look! That person over there...
Why's she here? Paimon thought she'd be at Silvermoon Hall...
Heh, funny how life works sometimes. Let's go over and say hi!
Hey! Columbina! Where are you going!?
Agh, she's gone too far out. She can't hear us.
But what's she doing here? Does she have something to do?

dialogue.sit: Let's follow her and take a look.

dialogue.t: Yeah. Paimon doesn't think she'll run into any trouble, but better safe than sorry.
Let's go!
This place looks like some sort of ruins...
Huh. What are those rings? Looks like they've fallen onto the ground or something.
Is that so? In that case, could this glowing sign next to it... be a manual, maybe?
Let Paimon see...
Alert! Alert!
Oh, darn it! Paimon triggered some kinda intruder alarm!
Alert! Alert!
Power transmission has ceased. Please head to the <color=#00E1FFFF>generator room</color> to activate backup power!
Oh, so it's just out of power! Gah, Paimon almost jumped outta her skin!

dialogue.sit: Reminds me of you when you're hungry, you know?

dialogue.t: What? C—C'mon, Paimon's way classier than that!

dialogue.sit: Let's go check this generator room out first.

dialogue.t: You mean...
Ohh, right! If Columbina came here to do something, she'd totally need to turn on the power first.

dialogue.sit: Right, and we might find her there.

dialogue.t: Haha, genius!
Alrighty then! Let's go!
Huh. This thing... doesn't really look very mechanical, but given where we found it, it must be the key to getting the power on somehow.
But Paimon doesn't see how that's supposed to work...

dialogue.sit: It doesn't look like the power's been turned on yet.

dialogue.t: Yeah, and that's super weird. Do you think Columbina's already been here? Maybe she discovered that the power wouldn't start, and went to look for a solution elsewhere?
Hmm. Y'know what? Let's give this thing a try anyway. Maybe we can find out what's going on...
Huh? Why isn't anything happening?
Paimon guessed as much... There's gotta be something else to this. Columbina must have run into this problem and then gone to look somewhere else... Huh!?
C—Columbina!? Thank goodness, we finally found you!
Hehe... Surprised to see us? We were worried you might be in trouble, so we followed you here.
Huh?
Erm...
...What's wrong? Are you trying to use telepathy, like Nicole? Just so you know, we aren't hearing anything!
Okay, now you're starting to worry Paimon...
Is someone threatening you!? If that's the case, just blink...
Huh? What did you do?
Do you want us to activate this?
Paimon's not sure what's going on, but it looks like Columbina wants us to activate this device. We should give it another try!
Awesome! The energy channels are clear! How did you do that, Columbina?
Wait! Where are you going?
We'd better catch up with her.

dialogue.section: Celestial Orbit, Mysterious Kuuhenki, Columbina, Talk

dialogue.t: Calculating celestial orbits. Please select the Trilune coordinates you wish to view.
Trilune coordinates!?
Wait, so this device is used to work out where the moons are?
Calculating celestial orbits. Please select the Trilune coordinates you wish to view.
Connection lost... Failed to locate target...
Whoa, it actually found the Frost Moon... But why would they need those coordinates anyways?
Frost Moon coordinates located. Base engineering blueprints and Main Control Hall route map have been transmitted.
Ooh! These look like schematics! Whatever these are showing, it looks super awesome!
Do you wish to obtain the route map?
Please proceed to the Main Control Hall for moon landing preparations.
M—Moon landing preparations!?
Columbina... is this place used for getting to the moon!?

dialogue.sit: (But Columbina has taken me to the Frost Moon before... Why would she need this device?)
(And the power she just gave me is completely new. I've never seen her use it before...)

dialogue.t: Oh! The door opened! This leads to the Main Control Hall, right? Columbina, is that where you want us to go?

dialogue.sit: Columbina, can you hold out your hand?
Place it in mine, just like we do in Silvermoon Hall.

dialogue.t: What's all this about?
Waaah! What's going on? Columbina turned into a black kuuhenki!
What!? An impostor!?
According to the route map, this should be the Main Control Hall, right?
Hey! You! The one pretending to be Columbina! Come out right now!
Alert! Intruder detected in Main Control Hall. Activating defense measures.
Wah! Sorry! Wrong address, we were looking for someone else!
Phew... It was no problem for you in the end! That should take care of things, right?
Alert! Main Control Hall Defender Core destruction confirmed. Initiating self-destruct mode.
All personnel, please evacuate immediately. Initiating countdown...
Seriously!? This base has gone crazy! It's trying to take us down with it... What should we do?
What if some really important intel gets destroyed!?
Please verify orbital coordinates.
Huh? What orbital coordinates? Whoa! Our mystery kuuhenki's back!
What are you doing? Will giving it the coordinates stop the base from self-destructing!?
What are the coordinates? Don't panic, don't panic, let Paimon think!
Please verify orbital coordinates.
Paimon remembers now... There were three symbols! The <color=#00E1FFFF>simplest-looking</color> one was first!
The second symbol had a <color=#00E1FFFF>super complicated</color> shape!
And lastly... Paimon can't quite remember, but it was probably the <color=#00E1FFFF>same as the second one</color>!
Orbital coordinate verification error.
Oh no! Did Paimon get the last one wrong? Okay. Don't panic, don't panic! Let's try again, real quick!
Please re-verify orbital coordinates.
One more time! First up, the <color=#00E1FFFF>simplest</color> symbol!
The second one's <color=#00E1FFFF>the most complicated</color>!
And the last one is... the last one is... Argh, what in Teyvat is the last one...?
It's <size=30><color=#FCD899>{REGEX#UNICODE[E001]}</color></size>
Ooh! Yes, yes! <color=#FCD899>{REGEX#UNICODE[E001]}</color>. That's the one! Wait. Who said that...? Ah, whatever! Let's punch it in!
Orbital coordinate verification: Successful. Engine ignition in progress. Please board the lunar spacecraft immediately.
Did we make it? Why's the alarm still going off!?
...Colum—
Was it you talking just now? Hey! Were you about to say "Columbina"?
...The moon...
On the moon? What... Has something happened to her?
...Rescue...
Rescue!? Is she asking us to go save Columbina!?
...Spaceship... Moon...
Take the spaceship? To the moon? Hey! Explain yourself!
What are we gonna do?! It feels like this place is gonna blow up any second!

dialogue.sit: There's no time. Let's go with it to the spaceship.

dialogue.t: Oh no! It's too late!

dialogue.sit:
You fail to stop the self-destruct sequence, and as the countdown ends, the base is engulfed in roaring flames.
The good news is you manage to escape the explosion unscathed with Paimon in tow.
But alas, the mysterious black kuuhenki, the spaceship bound for the moon, and the tale behind them all vanish from your journey forever.

dialogue.t: Whoa, we blasted off for real! Paimon was expecting a regular ol' vanilla adventure... but here we are flying to the moon!
Hey! You! Tell us what's going on, will ya!? What sort of trouble has Columbina gotten into?
Seriously? Playing dumb again!?

dialogue.sit: Say something, or I'll throw you into space.

dialogue.t: We definitely heard you speak just now, right? No, wait... You spoke through the base's systems, didn't you?
Huh, that's weird...
Then how about... we take a look around this ship? Let's see if we can find something to help you talk.
This vessel is bound for lunar orbit.
Huh? Is this escape pod broken?
There's something glowing inside!
Huh? She's here too? Does that mean there's something useful inside? But how do we get it out?

dialogue.sit: While you think, the kuuhenki slips into the escape pod. A moment later, she returns — carrying an item.

dialogue.t: What is that?
It's the spaceship's... archaeolune spectrometer...
Whoa, is that your voice? You can talk through this thing?
Mmhmm... Power of the ancient moons... transmit messages...
Huh? That sounds a lot like Phlogiston... Could this be dragon technology?
Not...
Do you mean "no"?
No... Not wrong...
...Why do you pant so much when you talk?

dialogue.sit: It looks like the base and the spaceship were made by the dragons.

dialogue.t: No wonder we ran into their Secret Source Automatons back there!
But what does this all have to do with Columbina? Why did you turn into her?
Columbina... Moon... Rescue...
Did she run into trouble and send you to get help?
Not...
Not wrong?
Not right...
...Can you... take it from the top and tell us the whole story? What exactly is going on?
Columbina... rescued me... on the moon...
Huh? She rescued you? So she hasn't sent us a plea for help?
That's... right...
Then why did you tell us to get on this spaceship?
I wanted to... go back to the moon...
Not... you...
Oh no... In that case... what does that make us?

dialogue.sit: People who came along of their own accord...

dialogue.t: No, no, how could this happen? We're not that clueless, are we?
Hey, you! You're leaving something out, aren't you? You said Columbina rescued you. That means you were in danger!
Not...
Not what this time? Not wrong? Not right?
Not... sure...
...Ugh, this is really starting to get on Paimon's nerves...
I'm sorry... I'm not sure...
When I woke up... I was very weak... I forgot... many things...
She took me to... a place of healing...
It was called... Silvermoon Hall...
Oh? Did Columbina tell you to stay there and rest? Then why did you come here?
...I must... return to the moon...
...There lies... my mission...
What mission?
...I forgot...
How could you forget something like that!?

dialogue.sit: So your home is on the moon?

dialogue.t: Oh, right! You keep talking about going back to the moon... So you're not a local kuuhenki from Teyvat?
Yes... I belong on... the moon...
Is Columbina there right now?
Yes... if... she hasn't left...
Well, that explains it! Paimon's got it all figured out now.
Columbina wasn't in trouble... She just picked this kuuhenki up while strolling around the moon and sent her to Silvermoon Hall.
But our girl's got a little problem... she either doesn't talk at all, or has to pant her way to the finish line...
And now the two of us have gone whoosh and flown right out of Teyvat, like a couple of silly Anemo Slimes hit by an arrow!

dialogue.sit: We're already in flight. Might as well make our peace with it.

dialogue.t: Ugh... You tricked us, and that makes you a bad egg in Paimon's books! From now on, she's gonna call you, uhm... Eggie!
*sob*... Good Hunter, Wanmin Restaurant, Shimura's... Will we ever meet again?
...I'm... sorry...
Hey, hey... Are those tears...? Uhm, maybe Paimon was a little too mean? Please don't cry...
Psst, Eggie! Paimon isn't really this upset! She's just pretending so that {NICKNAME} might buy her more snacks later on...
If you play along, we can split the snacks twenty-eighty... Alright?
Snacks?
Ahem! Anyway... Eggie, you're the one who made us think Columbina was in danger! There's no way we could have sat back and done nothing knowing a friend was in trouble.
So you have to take full responsibility for the situation we're in right now!

dialogue.sit: We can head back once we find Columbina.

dialogue.t: ...I can... help...
Hmm... Then it's settled! Let's make this a surprise visit for Columbina! Who knows, maybe she'll be really happy to have friends come and play with her!

dialogue.sit: You cheered up quickly, hey, Paimon?

dialogue.t: Ahem... Well. Paimon suddenly realized that we'll soon be famous as the first adventurers to set foot on the moon! One small step for us, one big step for Teyvat, right?
And don't you start saying you've already been! Columbina helped you cheat, so that doesn't count.
This vessel is about to enter lunar orbit. Please select a landing site.
Ooh! Are we almost there? Let's go check it out!
This vessel is about to enter lunar orbit. Please select a landing site.
There are so many landing sites, but they all have super weird names... Which one should we pick?

dialogue.sit: Connection failed. Please select another location.

dialogue.t: Connection established. Confirm landing thruster initiation?
Connection established. Initiating landing thruster...
Whoa! Are we getting ready to land?

quests.description: You catch sight of Columbina in the distance on a deserted island on the east side of Piramida. Worried that your friend has encountered trouble, you chase after her, and in so doing, embark on an adventure into the unknown…
